item.title: pi-guardrails-explain, or having the dangerous command explained before you approve it
item.description: A pi extension that adds a one-line explanation to Guardrails' prompt before you approve a bash command, and never decides for you.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: Pi subagent extensions: TintinWeb, NicoBailon and Taskplane
item.description: A comparison of three extensions for running subagents in pi — TintinWeb, NicoBailon, and Taskplane — each with a different approach.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
